purpose: Provide a complete, inspectable audit trail for a property-law answer from the user's question through official evidence to the final answer.

required_fields.property_identifier: Address, folio or other identifier actually supplied/verified.
required_fields.date_scope: Current or historical date relevant to the question.
required_fields.record_route: Official retrieval route selected by the route engine.
required_fields.retrieval_event_id: Identifier for the actual retrieval event.
required_fields.document_type: Folio, title plan, official search, Registry of Deeds record, filed instrument, etc.
required_fields.source_url: Official source or retrieval destination where applicable.
required_fields.retrieval_date: Date the record was actually retrieved.
required_fields.extracted_facts: Only facts actually present in the record.
required_fields.proposition_ids: Canonical propositions supported by the evidence.
required_fields.legal_effect: Effect determined from applicable law, not merely document wording.
required_fields.last_verified: Date the answer/evidence chain was last verified.

audit_rules: Every material answer must be traceable to at least one proposition and evidence chain.
A proposition without supporting evidence cannot be presented as verified.
A retrieved document must retain retrieval date and source.
Historical evidence must retain the relevant date and legal version.
Conflicting evidence must remain visible until resolved.
If the chain breaks, the answer must downgrade to the appropriate non-definitive result.
The audit record must not expose unnecessary personal data.
Public-facing answers may show a simplified audit while retaining the full internal evidence chain.

answer_trace_examples.registered_owner: QUESTION -> PROPERTY_IDENTIFIER -> FOLIO_ROUTE -> FOLIO -> REGISTERED_OWNER_FACT -> PROP-PROPERTY-TITLE-001 -> LEGAL_EFFECT -> ANSWER
answer_trace_examples.boundary_issue: QUESTION -> PROPERTY_IDENTIFIER -> TITLE_PLAN/FOLIO -> MAP_FACT -> SURVEY_OR_OTHER_EVIDENCE -> PROP-PROPERTY-MAP-002 -> LEGAL_EFFECT -> ANSWER
answer_trace_examples.historical_title: QUESTION -> DATE_SCOPE -> HISTORICAL_RECORD_ROUTE -> HISTORICAL_RECORD -> FACT -> PROP-PROPERTY-REGISTRATION-003 -> HISTORICAL_LEGAL_VERSION -> ANSWER
